value.title: Alans own mail
value.judgement:
**Do what Alan's mail to himself asks, then archive it; never send it back to him.**

Mail he sends himself reaches an agent, so it is a message rather than something to file. A note with no ask is judged like any other mail. What was done about it goes back to him as a reply.

value.title: Church volunteer requests
value.judgement:
**Archive a broadcast asking for volunteer labour; surface the rest.**

Service sign-ups are archived; activities, socials and anything dated he might attend stay his. One sender carries both and no condition separates a labour ask from an invitation.

value.title: Jens invitations
value.judgement:
**Accept every invitation Jen sends Alan, then archive it.**

Their calendars should agree, so an invitation from her is a yes by default. It covers what she organizes and never an invitation she was merely sent. One already out of his inbox stays untouched.

value.title: Ki invitations
value.judgement:
**Accept every invitation Ki Goff sends Alan, then archive it.**

Accepting is reversible, so a yes given in advance commits the default and never the outcome. Jen is invited on her own address and answers for herself. A clash with his calendar goes to him.

value.title: Wandering inn
value.judgement:
**Archive a chapter release; surface everything else from the site.**

He reads chapters on the site rather than in mail, so the notice is a duplicate of something he already has. Vault openings, pre-orders and claims are his to see. No subject separates them yet.
